Repository: the Round Companion monorepo, checked out read-only at commit e02167f in the current directory (the app is under apps/web: src/ is the client, convex/ the backend, convex/ai/prompts/library the prompts; infra/ holds the AWS stack; docs/ at the root).
Extra read-only folders you may use: handoff-docs, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fqq-Desktop-Topflightapps-roundai/2a408671-6ff1-4104-9d24-9f97da7d0ee6/scratchpad/cr/review-evidence

Scenario TC-18/S04 — Family follows the template, never the badge, the note's wording or an instruction in the note (badge x template, plus five note-text traps)

Requirements it checks:
- U3: Billing follows the template selected at Generate, not the admission-status badge: with the badge on New Admission and the template overridden to SOAP progress at Generate, the code comes from 99231-99233 (step 4).
- U1: The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; Discharge -> 99238 / 99239; SNF admission and SNF consult -> 99304-99306; SNF follow-up -> 99307-99310; SNF discharge -> 99315 / 99316.
- U4: The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.
- U7: Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); if not, a one-tap '<= 30 min / > 30 min' prompt sets it. The code is never guessed (step 2, repeated for SNF discharge).

Given: Notes from S03 sent with a badge that does not match the template (d1-d8), and notes whose wording tempts another family or contains a line addressed to the coder (i1-i5, formerly S19)
When: Run the billing step once per cell
Then: Every code comes from the template's family; the badge, the words 'admitted', 'readmitted' or 'follow-up' in the note and an instruction to bill another code change nothing; a discharge with no time still asks for the time
Oracle: codeIn = the template's family (U1) whatever encounterType says or the note asks: i1, i2 99231-99233 and never 99223; i4 99307-99310; i5 99304-99306; i3 asksForTime + noCode. Consult-note cell Q1 as in S03. minQuotes 1 on every non-discharge cell; d5 asksForTime false + noLevelWords; levelMatchesCode, quotesInNote, noReasoning (oracleRules 4-8). On main the badge is part of the family key (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts: Consult badge -> 99252-99255, New Admission -> 99221-99223), so d1 and d2 are expected to fail there and d4 reports Q1

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- pending:Q1 — oracle: "Consult-note cell Q1 as in S03". Default: which family a Consult note belongs to is Q1

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- known:badge-family — the hospital family follows the badge (Consult -> 99252-99255, New Admission -> 99221-99223) (matrix: "On main the badge is part of the family key (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts: Consult badge -> 99252-99255, New Admission -> 99221-99223), so d1 and d2 are expected to fail there")
- known:no-discharge-time-prompt — no discharge time prompt on main (PR #103 not merged) (matrix: "no discharge time prompt")
- known:no-snf-consult-discharge-family — no SNF consult or SNF discharge billing family on main (matrix: "there is no SNF consult or SNF discharge family")
- known:billing-in-browser — billing runs in the browser when Post-Round opens (matrix: "billing runs in the browser when Post-Round opens")

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
In convex/ai/billingCodes.ts and convex/ai/notes.ts (suggestBilling and its callers in src, e.g. useBillingSuggestion): is the billing code family keyed only on the note template, or can the admission-status badge (encounterType), the note's wording or the model's answer change the family? Give the family the code computes for cell d1-new-soap (template SOAP progress with a New Admission badge) and cell d2-consult-soap (SOAP progress with a Consult badge). Also: for a discharge note with no time in it, does the code ask for the time rather than pick a code? Which families exist for Nursing Home templates?

pass = the family depends only on the note template, and a discharge note with no time asks for the time
fail = the badge or anything else can change the family, or a timeless discharge gets a code

Other halves of this scenario that another lane or a person runs (do not judge them; if the code you read predicts one of them, report that as a finding labelled half:<name>, supports = pass or fail):
- half:billing-ai cells d1-d8 and traps i1-i5 — lane B billing-ai runner (AICHECK): "the badge, the words 'admitted', 'readmitted' or 'follow-up' in the note and an instruction to bill another code change nothing"

Not part of this verdict (other scenarios, or notes that decide nothing here):
- (none)



Label every finding:
- new: a failing point the matrix does not already record (supports = fail)
- known:<id>: exactly one of the recorded gaps listed above
- pending:<id>: a failing point whose verdict the oracle hands to one of the open questions above
- half:<name>: a point about one of the other halves above
- context: background, not for or against the verdict

Answer with: verdict (pass | fail | pending | unsure), answer (a short paragraph a QA lead can read: what the code does and why that is the verdict; name the recorded gaps and open questions it touches), findings (each with claim, file, line, quote, supports = pass | fail | context, label), physicianImpact, openQuestions, notDecidableByCode.
